product_metadata.title: Sticky Toffee Waffle Kitchen Towels Set of 3, White Waffle Weave Dish Towels for Kitchen, Absorbent Waffle Hand Towels, Oeko-Tex Cotton Tea Towels, 28 in x 16 in
features: ABSORBENT WAFFLE WEAVE: These towels are woven in a waffle construction resulting in a fast-drying, lofty, casual fabric adding that unique vintage touch to your kitchen. The honeycomb weave is designed to soak up water and be more absorbent than other towel constructions.

PRE-SHRUNK 100% OEKO-TEX COTTON: Waffle cotton towels tend to shrink quite a bit, so we've taken some of the headache out by pre-washing them for you! These dish rags are made of 100% Oeko-Tex cotton, meaning this product surpasses the highest standard of testing and helps you to make responsible decisions that protect our planet for future generations.
EASY CARE: Machine wash and dry for stress-free care. These dish towels are made of durable, high-quality cotton yarn resulting in a thick, absorbent towel to assist with all your kitchen needs.
SET OF THREE VALUE PACK: Collection includes 3 classic white towels. The towels measure 28 in x 16 in large.
GIFT: Decorated with charming, chic packaging, these towels make a great hostess, wedding or housewarming gift.
